rows.question: What did later checks establish about nine of the twelve suspected duplicates?
rows.correctOption: They were display errors rather than repeated shipments
rows.reasonEn: Evidence: The review found that the first reconciliation run contained twelve apparent duplicates, but later checks showed that nine were display errors rather than repeated physical shipments.

rows.question: Why should billing for affected stores be delayed?

rows.question: Which condition is part of declaring the incident fully resolved?
rows.correctOption: Producing a clean reconciliation and testing against duplicate reservations

rows.question: The office will close early ___ Friday because staff members are attending a safety workshop.
rows.reasonEn: We use “on” with a named day of the week.
rows.reasonZh: 星期幾前使用 on。

rows.question: Maria ___ the travel request yesterday, but her manager has not approved it yet.
rows.reasonEn: “Yesterday” points to a completed past action, so the simple past “submitted” is required.
rows.reasonZh: yesterday 指已完成的過去動作，用過去式 submitted。

rows.question: Please send the revised contract to Daniel and ___ before noon.
rows.reasonEn: After the preposition “to,” use the object pronoun “me.”
rows.reasonZh: 介系詞 to 後面使用受格 me。

rows.question: All visitors must wear ___ identification badge while they are inside the laboratory.
rows.reasonEn: “Identification” begins with a vowel sound, and the singular count noun needs “an.”
rows.reasonZh: identification 發母音起首，單數可數名詞前用 an。

rows.question: The shipment arrived late ___ heavy rain had closed the main highway.
rows.reasonEn: “Because” introduces the stated cause of the shipment delay.
rows.reasonZh: 大雨封閉道路導致延遲，應用 because 表原因。

rows.question: The new label printer is considerably ___ than the model purchased last year.
rows.reasonEn: “Than” signals a comparative adjective; “faster” is the correct form.
rows.reasonZh: 有 than 的兩者比較句，使用 faster。

rows.question: By the time the delivery driver arrived yesterday afternoon, the warehouse supervisor ___ every package label, allowing the truck to leave immediately.
rows.reasonEn: The label checks occurred before another past event; the past perfect “had checked” shows the earlier action.
rows.reasonZh: 標籤檢查先於昨日司機抵達，須用過去完成式。

rows.question: Although the agreement has already been reviewed by the legal team, it will not take effect ___ representatives of both companies sign the revised schedule.
rows.reasonEn: “Not ... until” expresses that the agreement becomes effective only after the signatures.
rows.reasonZh: not ... until 表示直到雙方簽署後才生效。

rows.question: Employees ___ assignments involve frequent entry to restricted areas must finish the online safety briefing before receiving their visitor access privileges.
rows.reasonEn: “Whose” introduces a relative clause showing that the assignments belong to the employees.
rows.reasonZh: whose 表所有關係，修飾 employees 的 assignments。

rows.question: The technical proposal presents three alternatives, only one of ___ requires replacing hardware; the remaining two can be implemented through software updates.
rows.reasonEn: After “only one of,” the relative pronoun “which” refers back to the three alternatives.
rows.reasonZh: only one of which 指三項替代方案中的其中一項。

rows.question: Because seasonal demand usually rises in December, the distribution center ___ extra temporary staff in preparation for the holiday shipments scheduled next week.
rows.reasonEn: The singular subject “distribution center” takes “has”; “hired” is the past participle in the present perfect.
rows.reasonZh: 單數主詞搭配 has，現在完成式用 has hired。

rows.question: The receptionist reminded conference attendees ___ their reusable identification badges at checkout so that the organizers could prepare them for the following morning.
rows.reasonEn: The pattern is “remind someone to do something,” so “to return” is required.
rows.reasonZh: remind + 人 + to V 是固定句型。

rows.question: While subscription revenue remained relatively stable during the first quarter, the finance committee warned that the apparent improvement in operating margin ___ primarily by one-time accounting adjustments rather than sustained reductions in operating costs.
rows.reasonEn: The singular subject “improvement” requires “was,” and the passive “was driven” correctly describes its cause.
rows.reasonZh: improvement 單數，且利潤率改善是「由調整造成」，故用 was driven。

rows.question: The revised compliance guidelines, which were circulated after an audit identified conflicting departmental procedures, require that every request for an exceptional payment arrangement ___ by an officer who did not participate in the initial approval.
rows.reasonEn: After the formal requirement “require that,” the mandative subjunctive uses the base-form passive “be reviewed.”
rows.reasonZh: require that 的要求語氣可用原形動詞，且申請須被審查，故 be reviewed。

rows.question: Had the manufacturer disclosed the production delays when it first submitted its proposal, the purchasing team ___ an alternative delivery schedule before the final contract was signed and the launch date announced.
rows.reasonEn: “Had the manufacturer disclosed” inverts a past unreal condition; the result takes “would have + past participle.”
rows.reasonZh: 過去與事實相反的假設，以 Had + S + p.p. 倒裝，結果用 would have negotiated。

rows.question: Not until the quality assurance department completed a second round of independent durability tests ___ the company authorize distribution of the revised devices to its regional partners, despite pressure to meet the original delivery schedule.
rows.reasonEn: “Not until” at the front triggers subject–auxiliary inversion; a completed past authorization requires “did.”
rows.reasonZh: Not until 置首須倒裝，主句過去式用 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

rows.question: The board agreed to extend the pilot project for another month, provided that the additional survey results ___ to an independent reviewer before members meet again to consider a permanent expansion of the service.
rows.reasonEn: The plural “results” need a passive verb; “are submitted” states the condition for extending the pilot.
rows.reasonZh: survey results 複數且須被提交，因此使用 are submitted。

rows.question: Even if the revised manufacturing timetable receives final approval next week, distribution must remain suspended ___ the independent auditor confirms that the earlier safety issue has been fully resolved under the company’s current inspection standards.
rows.reasonEn: “Unless” means distribution stays suspended if the auditor does not confirm resolution; the other choices do not express this condition.
rows.reasonZh: 除非稽核員確認問題已解決，否則配送繼續暫停，故用 unless。

rows.question: The revised safety manual will be distributed to all branch managers ___ the inspection begins next week.
rows.reasonEn: Before introduces an event that follows the distribution; during cannot connect directly to the finite clause here.
rows.reasonZh: 在下週檢查開始之前發放手冊，before 可引導時間子句。

rows.question: Neither the marketing director nor the regional supervisors ___ authorized to change the published prices without written approval.
rows.reasonEn: With neither...nor, agreement generally follows the nearer subject; supervisors is plural, so are is required.
rows.reasonZh: neither...nor 句型通常與較近的複數主詞 supervisors 一致，因此選 are。

rows.question: The hotel will waive the cancellation fee, provided that the guest ___ a medical certificate within five business days.
rows.reasonEn: Provided that introduces a real condition on a future waiver; the present simple submits states what the guest must do.
rows.reasonZh: provided that 為條件連接詞，此處以一般現在式表達須履行的條件。

rows.question: The laboratory must have its ventilation system ___ by a licensed engineer before the facility reopens.
rows.reasonEn: Have + object + past participle describes arranging for the system to be inspected by someone else.
rows.reasonZh: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞表使某事由他人完成，應為 inspected。

rows.question: The software license is valid for twelve months and may be renewed ___ the subscriber has complied with the usage policy.
rows.reasonEn: As long as states the condition for renewal; the other phrases do not express that requirement.
rows.reasonZh: 只要訂戶符合使用規範即可續約，應選表條件的 as long as。

rows.question: All participants are asked to return their visitor badges upon ___ the exhibition hall.
rows.reasonEn: The preposition upon takes a noun or gerund; leaving denotes the action of exiting.
rows.reasonZh: upon 是介系詞，後接動名詞 leaving 表「離開時」。

rows.question: The regional manager requested a summary ___ identifies which service complaints remain unresolved.
rows.reasonEn: That introduces a relative clause modifying the thing summary and serves as its subject.
rows.reasonZh: summary 為事物，關係代名詞 that 在子句中作主詞。

rows.question: The new scheduling platform is expected to operate more ___ than the version currently used by the warehouse.
rows.reasonEn: Operate is a verb modified by the comparative expression more efficiently, so an adverb is needed.
rows.reasonZh: operate 為動詞，需副詞 efficiently 修飾，構成比較 more efficiently。

rows.question: By the time the supplier confirmed the shipment, the purchasing team ___ an alternative delivery arrangement.
rows.reasonEn: The negotiation occurred before another past event, so the past perfect had negotiated marks the earlier action.
rows.reasonZh: 協商早於過去的「確認出貨」，故用過去完成式 had already negotiated。

rows.question: Only after the final inspection ___ permitted to occupy the renovated offices.
rows.reasonEn: Only after at the beginning triggers inversion in the main clause: were the employees permitted.
rows.reasonZh: Only after 置於句首時主句須倒裝，因此使用 were the employees。

rows.question: The coordinator arranged for two additional interpreters ___ at the conference registration desk.
rows.reasonEn: Arrange for someone to do something is the governing pattern; to assist completes it.
rows.reasonZh: arrange for + 人 + to V 是正確句型，因此選 to assist。

rows.question: ___ the online form had been submitted, applicants received an automated message listing the next steps.
rows.reasonEn: Once introduces a time clause stating what happened following submission of the form.
rows.reasonZh: Once 引導時間子句，說明表格送出後便收到系統訊息。

rows.question: Which option best completes blank [1] in the registration message?
rows.reasonEn: Has been confirmed is the present perfect passive describing a completed registration confirmation.
rows.reasonZh: has been confirmed 為現在完成被動，表示報名已確認。

rows.question: Which option best completes blank [3] in the registration message?

rows.question: Which option best completes blank [4] in the registration message?
rows.correctOption: Please view the digital program using the link in your confirmation message.

rows.reasonZh: 不發紙本議程，改使用電子議程，符合前後文。

rows.question: Which option best completes blank [1] in the delivery update?

rows.question: Which option best completes blank [2] in the delivery update?
rows.reasonEn: In contrast signals the distinction between eligible districts and customers outside the pilot area.
